## Origin

Tick one:

- [ ] **GitHub**: I made this change on a branch in this repository
- [ ] **Glean export**: the export is unzipped into `skills/<id>/` (the ZIP itself is not committed)
- [ ] **Assisted**: a maintainer opened this for a contributor without GitHub access; the contributor is the skill's `owner`

## Type

- [ ] New skill (`skills/<id>/SKILL.md` added)
- [ ] Update to an existing skill (`version` bumped)
- [ ] Tooling / docs / governance (no skill content)

## Checklist

- [ ] For a skill: `SKILL.md` is at the root of `skills/<id>/`, and `name` equals the folder name `<id>`
- [ ] No credentials, tokens, API keys, or client data are included
- [ ] A teammate other than the author has reviewed this exact change
- [ ] Content is appropriate for a public repository (check the Skill's `sensitivity`)
- [ ] I understand that publishing to Claude/Glean is separate from merging
